name: Asymmetric Threat Pressure & Foothold Escalation Holdout Family
description: Tests candidate autonomy predictors under severe asymmetric threat pressure (elevated initial insurgent share and rapid foothold renewal).

experimental_manipulation.rationale: High combat pressure tests whether candidate coordinates remain predictive under heavy loss rates and contested territorial stress.

pass_fail_criteria.decision_rule: The frozen discovery predictor must achieve Spearman rho >= 0.55 and MAE <= 0.30 across all horizons under high threat stress without recalibration.
